table inet novusgate { # handle 2
	set ssh_ports { # handle 6
		type inet_service
		elements = { 22, 2222 }
	}

	set wg_ports { # handle 7
		type inet_service
		flags interval
		elements = { 51820-51900, 51950 }
	}

	set blocked_v4 { # handle 8
		type ipv4_addr
		flags interval,timeout
		elements = { 192.0.2.9 timeout 1h expires 59m59s952ms, 198.51.100.0/24 }
	}

	set blocked_v6 { # handle 9
		type ipv6_addr
		flags interval,timeout
		elements = { 2001:db8:bad::/48 }
	}

	set egress_v4 { # handle 10
		type ipv4_addr
		elements = { 10.20.0.6, 10.20.0.7 }
	}

	set dropped_v4 { # handle 11
		type ipv4_addr
		size 4096
		flags dynamic,timeout
		timeout 1h
		elements = { 198.51.100.77 expires 59m59s984ms }
	}

	set dropped_v6 { # handle 12
		type ipv6_addr
		size 4096
		flags dynamic,timeout
		timeout 1h
		elements = { 2001:db8::99 expires 59m59s984ms }
	}

	chain input { # handle 1
		type filter hook input priority filter - 10; policy drop;
		iif "lo" accept # handle 13
		ip saddr @blocked_v4 counter packets 3 bytes 180 drop # handle 14
		ip6 saddr @blocked_v6 counter packets 0 bytes 0 drop # handle 15
		ct state established,related accept # handle 16
		ct state invalid drop # handle 17
		tcp dport @ssh_ports accept # handle 18
		udp dport @wg_ports accept # handle 19
		ip6 saddr fe80::/10 udp sport 547 udp dport 546 accept comment "dhcpv6 client" # handle 20
		iifname "wg0" tcp dport { 3007, 5432 } accept # handle 22
		iifname { "wg0", "wg1", "wg2" } tcp dport { 8080, 8443 } accept # handle 25
		tcp dport 443 accept comment "svc:https" # handle 26
		ip saddr 203.0.113.0/24 tcp dport 3389 accept comment "svc:office-rdp" # handle 27
		ip6 saddr 2001:db8::/32 tcp dport 3389 accept comment "svc:office-rdp" # handle 28
		iifname "wg1" udp dport 53 accept comment "svc:vpn-dns" # handle 29
		tcp dport { 3007, 5432, 8080, 8443 } counter packets 0 bytes 0 drop comment "admin ports: VPN only" # handle 31
		meta l4proto { icmp, ipv6-icmp } accept # handle 33
		update @dropped_v4 { ip saddr } # handle 34
		update @dropped_v6 { ip6 saddr } # handle 35
		counter packets 12 bytes 840 comment "default drop" # handle 36
	}

	chain forward { # handle 2
		type filter hook forward priority filter - 10; policy accept;
		ip saddr @blocked_v4 counter packets 0 bytes 0 drop # handle 37
		ip6 saddr @blocked_v6 counter packets 0 bytes 0 drop # handle 38
		ct state established,related accept # handle 39
		iifname "wg0" meta l4proto tcp ct original proto-dst 5432 ct status dnat accept comment "admin VPN to docker-published postgres" # handle 40
		meta l4proto tcp ct original proto-dst 5432 ct status dnat counter packets 0 bytes 0 drop comment "docker-published postgres" # handle 41
		iifname "wg*" jump vpn_policy # handle 42
		oifname "wg*" ct status dnat accept # handle 43
		oifname "wg*" counter packets 0 bytes 0 drop # handle 44
	}

	chain vpn_policy { # handle 3
		ip saddr 10.20.0.0/24 ip daddr 10.30.0.0/24 tcp dport 22 counter packets 0 bytes 0 drop comment "rule:block-ssh-a-b" # handle 45
		ip saddr 10.20.0.0/24 ip daddr 10.30.0.0/24 tcp dport { 80, 8000-8100 } counter packets 0 bytes 0 accept comment "rule:a-to-b-web" # handle 47
		ip daddr 10.30.0.10 meta l4proto icmp counter packets 0 bytes 0 accept comment "rule:any-ping" # handle 48
		iifname "wg0" oifname "wg0" accept # handle 49
		iifname "wg1" oifname "wg1" accept # handle 50
		iifname "wg2" oifname "wg2" accept # handle 51
		oifname "eth0" ip saddr @egress_v4 accept # handle 52
		counter packets 0 bytes 0 drop comment "vpn default drop" # handle 53
	}

	chain prerouting { # handle 4
		type nat hook prerouting priority dstnat; policy accept;
		iifname "eth0" tcp dport 8081 dnat ip to 10.20.0.5:80 comment "fwd:home-cam" # handle 54
	}

	chain postrouting { # handle 5
		type nat hook postrouting priority srcnat; policy accept;
		ip daddr 10.20.0.5 oifname "wg1" tcp dport 80 ct status dnat masquerade comment "fwd:home-cam" # handle 55
		oifname "eth0" ip saddr @egress_v4 masquerade # handle 56
	}
}
